_note: Week of June 22–28, 2026. Mediterranean, cold-leaning per Laine's request. Monday is the new Shrimp Caesar Salad — Caesar dressing (Greek-yogurt base) is this week's standalone sauce card, replacing the usual tzatziki/raita slot. Tuesday is standing Pita Tuesday: the pork tenderloin on hand + extra shrimp from Monday become Mediterranean pork & shrimp pita pockets. Wed (salmon) and Fri (cod) keep the 'more fish' push; Thursday is a fully cold no-cook Greek tuna & white bean salad for Laine's cold-Mediterranean craving. Saturday is a cold vegetarian chickpea salad. Sunday is standing breakfast-for-dinner — a Mediterranean egg + feta + spinach scramble with pita, not waffles (Birch Benders stay Sunday morning only). No raw onion, no mushrooms, no lentils, no okra/eggplant anywhere. Chicken stays out of dinners (Jake's lunch batch only); pork is the one moderate red-meat night.

tzatziki.name: Caesar Dressing
tzatziki.note: Classic Caesar — egg yolk emulsified with oil, anchovy paste, garlic, lemon, Dijon, and Worcestershire. Makes ~10 tbsp (5 servings). Keeps 3–4 days refrigerated.
steps: Whisk together the egg yolk, anchovy paste, Dijon, Worcestershire, lemon juice, and garlic until combined.
Slowly drizzle in the olive oil while whisking constantly to emulsify. Start with a few drops at a time, then a thin stream once it begins to thicken.
Season with black pepper. Taste and adjust lemon or anchovy. Should coat the back of a spoon.
Refrigerate until ready to use. Keeps 3–4 days.

dinners.name: Shrimp Caesar Salad
dinners.note: Seared shrimp over crisp romaine with Caesar dressing and quick stovetop croutons. Not a fish night, so it doesn't touch the Monday no-fish rule. Jake gets extra shrimp, croutons, and dressing; Laine's stays lighter on the croutons.

ingredients.item: Frozen shrimp — Jake 230g, Laine 150g raw (buy extra for Tuesday)
Parmesan cheese, grated — Jake 2 tbsp, Laine 1.5 tbsp, for topping
Whole grain bread — Jake 1.25 slices, Laine ¾ slice, cubed for croutons
Olive oil — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp (croutons + searing shrimp)
Caesar dressing — 2–3 tbsp per person (see recipe card)

steps: Cube the bread, toss with a little olive oil and garlic powder, and toast in a dry skillet (or 400°F oven) 6–8 min, tossing, until crisp. Set aside.
Pat shrimp dry, season with salt and pepper. Sear in olive oil 1–2 min per side until just pink. Don't crowd the pan.
Toss chopped romaine with most of the Caesar dressing, then plate.
Top with shrimp, croutons, cherry tomatoes, and a final shaving of parmesan. Extra dressing on the side. Jake gets more shrimp and croutons.

dinners.name: Pork Tenderloin & Shrimp Pita Pockets
dinners.note: Standing leftovers-plus-a-treat night, Mediterranean style. The pork tenderloin you've got on hand is the treat protein; the extra shrimp from Monday's Caesar shopping is the leftover-style component. Lemon-garlic yogurt sauce keeps it cool, feta and cucumber round it out.

ingredients.item: Pork tenderloin — Jake 140g, Laine 95g raw, sliced into strips
Feta cheese (reduced fat) — Jake 25g, Laine 20g, crumbled
Greek yogurt (plain nonfat) — Jake 3 tbsp, Laine 2.5 tbsp (lemon-garlic sauce)
Olive oil — Jake 1.2 tbsp, Laine 0.8 tbsp

steps: Mix the yogurt sauce: yogurt, lemon juice, half the minced garlic, a pinch of oregano and salt. Set aside.

Slice pork tenderloin into thin strips, toss with olive oil, the rest of the garlic, oregano, paprika, salt. Sear in a hot pan 4–5 min, turning, until just cooked through (145°F). Rest, then slice thinner if needed.
Pat shrimp dry, season lightly, sear in the same pan 2 min per side until pink.
Warm the pitas. Split and fill with pork, shrimp, cucumber, tomato, feta, and a generous spoon of the yogurt sauce. Jake gets the bigger pita and more of both proteins.

dinners.name: Baked Salmon + Farro + Greek Salad
dinners.note: More-fish night. Simple roasted salmon alongside a lemony farro and a small Greek salad — olives, feta, cucumber, cherry tomato. Onion-free, mild, and quick.

ingredients.item: Feta cheese (reduced fat) — Jake 15g, Laine 15g, crumbled
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 0.75 tbsp

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Pat salmon dry, season with salt, oregano, and a squeeze of lemon. Roast skin-side down 12–14 min until just opaque and flaky.
Cook farro: simmer in salted water 20–25 min until tender, drain, toss with a little olive oil and lemon juice.
Toss cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, and feta with the remaining olive oil and lemon for the salad.
Plate salmon over farro with the Greek salad alongside. Jake gets the bigger fillet.

dinners.name: Cold Greek Tuna & White Bean Salad
dinners.note: Laine's cold-Mediterranean request, fully realized — no stove needed. Tuna, cannellini beans, cucumber, tomato, olives, feta, and a big handful of spinach, dressed simply in lemon and olive oil. Make it ahead and eat it cold straight from the fridge.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — Jake 1.5 cans, Laine 1 can, drained
Cannellini beans — Jake ~0.45 can, Laine ~0.35 can, rinsed
Feta cheese (reduced fat) — Jake 25g, Laine 20g, crumbled
Baby spinach — Jake 60g, Laine 60g, roughly chopped
Olive oil — Jake 1.2 tbsp, Laine 0.9 tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1.5 tbsp

steps: Drain and flake the tuna into a large bowl. Rinse and add the cannellini beans.
Add cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, feta, and spinach.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, and salt; pour over and toss gently.
Chill at least 20 min — better after an hour. Serve cold. No cooking required tonight.

dinners.name: Mediterranean Baked Cod + Quinoa + Cherry Tomatoes
dinners.note: Second fish night of the week. Cod roasted with garlic, lemon, and burst cherry tomatoes over quinoa — light, fast, and mild.

ingredients.item: Olive oil — Jake 1.2 tbsp, Laine 0.9 tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1.5 tbsp

steps: Preheat oven to 400°F. Place cod in a baking dish, scatter cherry tomatoes and olives around it, drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, and salt.
Bake 16–18 min until the cod flakes and the tomatoes blister.
Meanwhile cook quinoa: rinse, simmer in 2× water 15 min, rest 5 min, fluff.
Plate quinoa, top with cod and the pan juices/tomatoes. Jake gets the bigger piece.

dinners.name: Greek Chickpea Salad with Feta
dinners.note: Vegetarian, fully cold-friendly night — chickpeas (not lentils), cucumber, tomato, olives, feta, and spinach, with warm pita on the side for Jake. Keeps the week's onion-free, mild streak going.

ingredients.item: Garbanzo beans — Jake ~0.4 can, Laine ~0.28 can, rinsed
Feta cheese (reduced fat) — Jake 40g, Laine 30g, crumbled
Whole wheat pita — Jake ½ pita (Laine skips)
Olive oil — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1 tbsp
Lemon juice — Jake 1.5 tbsp, Laine 1.5 tbsp

steps: Combine chickpeas, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, feta, and spinach in a big bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, oregano, and salt; toss through the salad.
Let it sit 10–15 min so the spinach softens slightly and the flavors meld.
Warm Jake's pita on the side. Serve cold or room temp.

dinners.name: Mediterranean Egg, Feta & Spinach Scramble with Pita
dinners.note: Standing breakfast-for-dinner — doesn't have to be waffles, and isn't this week. Soft scrambled eggs with spinach, feta, and burst cherry tomatoes, warm pita on the side. Mild, fast, and a nice bookend to the week.

ingredients.item: Liquid egg whites — Jake ⅛ cup, Laine ⅛ cup
Feta cheese (reduced fat) — Jake 25g, Laine 20g, crumbled
Whole wheat pita — Jake 1, Laine ½
Olive oil — Jake 1 tbsp, Laine 0.75 tbsp

steps: Warm olive oil in a nonstick pan. Add cherry tomatoes, cook 2–3 min until they start to blister.
Add spinach, wilt 1 min.
Beat eggs and egg whites together, pour in, scramble gently over medium-low until just set.
Fold in feta off the heat so it stays soft. Warm the pitas and serve alongside.

jakeLunch.name: Greek Chicken & Farro Bowl
jakeLunch.note: Mediterranean batch bowl, same 5-container Sunday format, no fish (office-friendly). Lemon-garlic chicken, farro, cucumber, cherry tomato, olives, and feta. No dressing batched in — add a squeeze of lemon and a drizzle of olive oil fresh when eating.

ingredients.item: Chicken breast — ~3 lbs total (270g raw per container)
Feta cheese (reduced fat) — 25g per container, crumbled

steps: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt — 20–30 min if you have time.
Cook all the farro at once: simmer in salted water 20–25 min, drain, fluff.
Grill or pan-sear the chicken in batches, ~6–7 min per side until 165°F. Rest, then slice or dice.
Divide into 5 containers: farro, chicken, cucumber, cherry tomatoes, olives, feta. Add a fresh squeeze of lemon and drizzle of olive oil when reheating/eating.

laineLunch.name: Greek Tuna & Pasta Jar — Mason Jar Style
laineLunch.note: Mediterranean cold jar. Tuna, pasta, chickpeas, bell pepper, cucumber, olives, and feta, eaten cold over two sittings. No chicken, no lentils.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Lemon-olive oil vinaigrette: 1 tbsp olive oil + ½ tbsp lemon juice + pinch oregano + salt, drizzled in just before eating rather than batched.

ingredients.item: Canned tuna in water — 1 can per jar (5 cans total)
Garofalo pasta (rotini or penne) — 225g dry total, 45g per jar
Feta cheese (reduced fat) — ~20g per jar, crumbled
Olive oil — ~1 tbsp per jar (dressing, separate)

steps: Cook pasta in salted water, drain, rinse cold, toss with a tiny bit of olive oil.
Dice bell pepper, slice cucumber, drain tuna well, rinse chickpeas, halve olives.
Layer each jar: pasta → chickpeas → tuna → bell pepper + cucumber → olives + feta → spinach on top.
Mix the lemon-olive oil dressing; portion into a small separate container per jar.
To eat: pour in dressing, shake, eat half — reseal for the second sitting.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl. Top with thawed berries and flaxseed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Mediterranean Egg White Scramble
laineBreakfasts.note: Spinach, cherry tomato, and feta — mild, light, no heat.
steps: Sauté cherry tomatoes 1–2 min in a dry nonstick pan until they start to soften.
Add egg whites, scramble over medium-low until just set.
Toss in spinach at the end. Top with feta and a pinch of oregano.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Waffles + Berries
laineBreakfasts.note: Standing Sunday-morning waffles — separate from Sunday's breakfast-for-dinner.

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake/waffle mix — ½ cup dry

steps: Mix batter: mix + egg whites + water per package. Stir in flaxseed.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron 3–4 min until crisp.
Top with thawed berries.

laineSnacks.name: Banana + Greek Yogurt
laineSnacks.desc: 1 banana + 1 Oikos Triple Zero. Potassium + calcium snack.

laineSnacks.name: Cucumber + Hummus
laineSnacks.desc: ½ cucumber sliced + ~4 tbsp hummus for dipping. No raita this week — hummus fills the cool, dippable slot.

laineSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas
laineSnacks.desc: ¼ cup crunchy roasted chickpeas. Fiber + plant protein, lightly spiced.

laineSnacks.name: Greek Yogurt + Berries
laineSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos Triple Zero + small handful thawed berries.

jakeSnacks.name: Tuna Straight from Can
jakeSnacks.desc: Drain and eat with a fork. Lemon + a pinch of oregano.

jakeSnacks.name: Cottage Cheese + Banana
jakeSnacks.desc: ½ cup cottage cheese + 1 banana. Calcium + potassium.

jakeSnacks.name: Roasted Chickpeas + Almonds
jakeSnacks.desc: ¼ cup roasted chickpeas + a small handful of almonds. Crunchy, fat + fiber to round out the day.

jakeSnacks.name: Kefir (plain lowfat)
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup plain lowfat kefir. Strong calcium + B12 + probiotics.

Must Buy: Frozen shrimp — ~1.25 lbs (Mon Caesar + Tue pita)
Canned tuna in water — 8 cans (Thu dinner + Laine's 5 lunch jars)
Chicken breast — ~3 lbs (Jake's lunch batch only)
Dijon mustard — small jar, if not already on hand
Worcestershire sauce — small bottle, if not already on hand
Feta cheese (reduced fat) — 2 containers (~10oz total, used most nights)
Plain nonfat Greek yogurt — 1 large tub (Caesar dressing + Tue pita sauce)
Check Supply: Parmesan cheese, grated — small wedge or shaker (~⅓ cup needed)
Whole grain bread — a few slices (Mon croutons)
Liquid egg whites — 1–2 cartons (breakfasts + Sun dinner)
Oikos Triple Zero — 6+ containers (Laine breakfasts + snacks)
Garlic — check you have a few cloves left
Oregano / thyme / cumin / paprika — restock the spice tin if low
Already Have: Pork tenderloin — the one already in the freezer/fridge (Tue pita)
Olive oil — check bottle is at least half full

extras.name: Garlic Parmesan Croutons
extras.note: Quick stovetop croutons for Monday's Caesar salad — no need to turn on the oven. Scales easily; double it if you want extras for snacking.
steps: Cube the bread into bite-sized pieces.
Toss with olive oil, garlic powder, and salt.
Toast in a dry skillet over medium heat 6–8 min, tossing often, until golden and crisp on all sides.
Toss with grated parmesan off the heat. Cool slightly before adding to the salad so they stay crunchy.
